_comment: Hand-reviewed links from planner foods to records in other food composition tables. See README.md in this folder. verdict: 'accept' = same food, part and state, composition agrees; 'check' = plausible but something differs, owner to decide; 'none' = the table has no record of the same food. 'code' AND 'name' must both match the table (CoFID 2021 reuses code 13-669). Only 'accept' entries may ever be merged, and only for nutrients our USDA record lacks. 'sameFood' (for accept/check entries) says whether the record is the planner's food itself, regardless of whether its composition agrees with USDA's: a single-table mode uses every record with sameFood true, because it does not mix tables.
